mapper.update: UPDATE T_USER SET MAIN_RESUME_NUM = NULL WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND USER_IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.select: SELECT R.RESUME_NUM, R.RESUME_TITLE, R.OCCUPATION_CODE, O.OCCUPATION_NAME, R.JOB_CODE, J.JOB_NAME FROM T_USER U JOIN T_RESUME R ON R.RESUME_NUM = U.MAIN_RESUME_NUM AND R.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM LEFT JOIN T_OCCUPATION O ON O.OCCUPATION_CODE = R.OCCUPATION_CODE LEFT JOIN T_JOB J ON J.JOB_CODE = R.JOB_CODE AND J.OCCUPATION_CODE = R.OCCUPATION_CODE WHERE U.USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND U.USER_IS_DELETED = 0
